text.title: Spec Advanced Guidelines Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example showing inputs → procedure → output for a typical instance of Spec Advanced Guidelines, plus section-level examples of the FR → US → AC traceability chain and a measurable NFR.

example.scenario: A regulated payments feature: triggers fire for regulated + source-of-truth. NFR table lists p95 latency < 250ms, throughput ≥ 200 RPS, PII at rest encrypted (AES-256); AC rubric scores 9/10 average; glossary defines 8 terms; versioning records 2 revisions; content_id stable across the impl-plan and tests.
example.trace: r1-trigger-blocks-mandatory → r2-nfr-table-thresholds → r3-ac-rubric-applied → r5-versioning-record → r6-source-of-truth-pointer → artefact green

example.title: Traceability chain: FR traces to US, AC validates FR
example.code:
### FR-001: Add item to cart Traces to: US-001 (As Sarah, I want to add products to cart with one click)
**AC-001** (validates FR-001): Given Sarah is on a product page, When she clicks "Add to Cart", Then the cart count increments by 1 and a confirmation toast appears.
**AC-002** (validates FR-001): Given the product is out of stock, When Sarah clicks "Add to Cart", Then the button is disabled and shows "Out of Stock".
example.note: Satisfies r-traceability-chain, r-ac-given-when-then and r-ac-coverage-matrix (happy path + error case).

example.title: Measurable NFR with target, measurement and validation
example.code: ### NFR-001: Add to Cart Latency **Requirement:** Add to cart operation SHALL complete in < 200ms at p95. **Measurement:** Client-side total time from click to UI update (Performance API). **Priority:** Must **Validation:** Load test with 500 concurrent users, measure p95 latency.
